Trump and Putin ‌in Talks to End Russia-Ukraine War In a surprising revelation, ‍former ⁢U.S. President Donald Trump disclosed in an interview with the New York Post that he had a telephone conversation with ​Russian President Vladimir Putin.⁤ The discussion reportedly centered around finding a resolution to the ongoing conflict in Ukraine.This development marks the first direct dialog between Putin and an American president since the ⁤start of ‌the war in 2022.

Focus on Peace: ⁤ The primary topic of discussion was the potential end ⁤to the ‌war ‌in ‍Ukraine. Putin’s Stance: Trump‌ expressed his ‍belief ⁤that Putin⁤ “cares” about reaching a peaceful resolution. Trump Calls‍ for End​ to Russia-Ukraine ⁤War, Plans Talks with⁣ Putin and Zelensky Former President Donald Trump has weighed in on the ongoing conflict between Russia ⁣and Ukraine, expressing his desire to see ‌an end to the war.​ In⁣ a⁢ recent interview, Trump emphasized the need‍ to ​stop the ‌bloodshed, stating that “so many ​people are killed” and that Putin wants ‍”no‍ more people to die.” He also reiterated his belief that the war could ⁤have ‍been avoided if he had been ⁢in ​office in⁤ 2022.

He attributed this to his good relationship with Putin, contrasting it‍ with ⁢the current‍ administration.⁣ “Biden‌ was a shame for our nation. A complete shame,” Trump stated.
